item.title: EFCC arraigns woman over alleged N62.5m pilgrims’ visa fraud
item.description: The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) has arraigned a woman, Hauwa Mohammed Abdulkadir, over an alleged N62.5 million fraud involving intending Muslim pilgrims seeking to travel to Saudi Arabia. Abdulkadir was brought before the Ilorin High Court by the EFCC’s Ilorin Zonal Directorate on a seven-count charge bordering on obtaining money under false pretences. The commission alleged that the defendant presented herself as a travel agent capable of securing Saudi Arabian visas and flight tickets for intending pilgrims, collecting various sums of money from her victims. According to the charge, one of the complainants, Saka Rauf Ajagbe, allegedly paid her N39.57 million between January and February 2026 for travel documents to enable him and others he represented to perform the Muslim pilgrimage. The EFCC also accused her of collecting N14.705 million from another complainant, Abdulmehumeen Abdulsalam, between December 2025 and April 2026 under similar circumstances. The commission said the defendant knew her representations about having the capacity to procure the travel documents were false. The alleged offences contravene Section 1(1)(a) of the Advance Fee Fraud and Other Fraud Related Offences Act, 2006, and are punishable under Section 1(3) of the same law. Abdulkadir pleaded not guilty to all seven counts when they were read to her. Following her plea, EFCC counsel, Rashidat Alao, asked the court to fix a date for trial and remand the defendant in custody pending the commencement of proceedings. However, defence counsel, O. A. Teni, urged the court to grant her bail, arguing that it would enable her to source funds for restitution. Presiding judge, Justice Haleema Saleeman, granted the defendant bail in the sum of N5 million, with three responsible sureties in like sum. The judge subsequently adjourned the case until December 3, 2026, for trial. The post EFCC arraigns woman over alleged N62.5m pilgrims’ visa fraud appeared first on Vanguard News .

Titans' Cam Ward is one loss away from making bleak NFL history
item.description: Titans' Cam Ward is one loss away from making bleak NFL history originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Tennessee Titans are not having a good 2026 NFL season. Cam Ward has shown some promise this year, which has been encouraging, but their defense is horrible, and the team has a 1-9 record. With how poorly the Titans have played, it shouldn't be a surprise that Ward has made some NFL history no player wants to set. But heading into Week 12 against the Jacksonville Jaguars , Ward is on the cusp of some all-time horrible history. As ESPN Research highlighted , if Ward loses to the Jaguars in Week 12, then he will have broken the record for most losses by a quarterback in their first two NFL seasons since at least 1950. Cam Ward is one loss away from breaking NFL QB losing record "Titans QB Cam Ward is 4-23 as a starting QB," ESPN Research shared. "A 24th loss would break a tie for the most losses by a starting QB in his first two NFL seasons since 1950." Ward has only three wins in his NFL career, with his 23 losses over the past two years being an incomprehensible stretch of losing for the second-year QB out of Miami. At 1-9 this year, with their lone win coming against the Indianapolis Colts back in Week 6, Ward has quite the history of losing in his career. Through two years and 26 games played, he has 23 losses. One more loss, and he'll have the most losses by any quarterback ever through the first two NFL seasons. With the Jaguars, the current AFC South division leaders, on the schedule for Week 12, it wouldn't be a surprise for the Titans to lose this week and give Ward the record. MORE : Dak Prescott makes Cowboys history as Jerry Jones delivers telling reaction after Titans blowout This isn't the kind of record anyone wants to set, but the Jaguars present a big challenge for Ward and Tennessee this week. But even if they beat the Jaguars, Ward is still likely to break this record if he's healthy. After facing Jacksonville in Week 12, the Titans have the following opponents on their schedule: Washington Commanders , Detroit Lions , Colts, Las Vegas Raiders , Pittsburgh Steelers , and Houston Texans . While the Titans could potentially beat the Colts, Raiders, Steelers, and Texans, the Commanders are playing well lately, and the Lions are one of the best teams in the league. Seeing this Titans team win out this year would be maybe the biggest surprise the NFL has seen in a long time. Ward hasn't broken this record, but it is very likely he'll break it at some point this year. Unfortunately, all signs point to Ward joining the NFL history books in his sophomore season, but for the wrong reasons. One more loss, and he'll have the most losses a QB has ever had through their first two NFL seasons since 1950. item.title: Ordine slams Milan’s Estupiñán: ‘Terror all over his face’
item.description: Ordine slams Milan’s Estupiñán: ‘Terror all over his face’ Franco Ordine has launched a stinging attack on Pervis Estupiñán, claiming the Milan full-back is “terrified” of making mistakes in a Rossoneri shirt. In the Corriere dello Sport, with quotes via TuttoMercatoWeb , the veteran journalist used his regular column to look at Milan’s individual performances after Thursday’s 4-2 comeback win at Olympiacos. “Estupiñán now has a complex about wearing the Milan shirt. Just look at his face when the cameras zoom in on him in key moments: he has terror painted all over it,” Ordine wrote. “And if you’re terrified of making mistakes, it’s mathematically certain that you’ll make them.” Estupiñán started in Piraeus, where Milan were missing Davide Bartesaghi through injury. However, he was replaced at half-time by Yunus Musah with the Rossoneri trailing 1-0, and Ruben Amorim’s changes then turned the game. TURIN, ITALY – AUGUST 23: Nikola Vlasic of Torino FC is challenged by Rafael Leao and Pervis Estupinan of AC Milan during the Serie A match between Torino FC and AC Milan at Stadio Olimpico Grande Torino on August 23, 2026 in Turin, Italy. (Photo by Valerio Pennicino/Getty Images) Estupiñán’s struggles at Milan The Ecuadorian joined from Brighton in July 2025 as Theo Hernández’s replacement. He arrived for a reported fee of €17m plus up to €2m in bonuses and add-ons, but has struggled to convince at San Siro. Ordine was far more positive about Christian Pulisic, who came off the bench to score the winner against Olympiacos. “Since returning after the World Cup, Pulisic has put together one gem after another, a string of goals each more beautiful and difficult than the last,” he wrote. “Last night’s, the 3-2, was a jewel of technique and precision, as well as instinct in picking the spot where Hutchinson’s pass would arrive.” ITALY – NOVEMBER 22: Christian Pulisic of AC Milan celebrates scoring his team’s fifth goal during the Serie A match between AC Milan and Frosinone Calcio at Stadio Giuseppe Meazza on November 22, 2026 in Italy. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images)

item.title: ¡Mexico U17 reached the last 32 at Qatar 2026 with Rojiblancos on board!
item.description: ¡Mexico U17 reached the last 32 at Qatar 2026 with Rojiblancos on board! With Rojiblanco involvement from the start, Mexico’s U-17 national team drew 0-0 with Venezuela in its third Group Stage match at the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026, played at Aspire Zone. Gerson Gutiérrez and André Godínez both started the match, as El Tri secured top spot in Group K. Both Guadalajara players were involved from the opening whistle. André Godínez , who also wore the captain’s armband, contributed in both defense and attack. In the 45+3rd minute, he sent a dangerous cross into the Venezuelan box, but the opposing defense managed to cut it out. Gerson Gutiérrez also looked to threaten the opposing goal. In the 74th minute, he connected with a header inside the box from a Miguel Rivera delivery, but the Venezuelan goalkeeper managed to save it. Six minutes later, the Rojiblanco forward tried again with a right-footed shot from the left side of the box, which was blocked by the defense. With this result, Mexico finished the opening stage unbeaten, with two wins and a draw, reaching seven points and taking first place in Group K ahead of Venezuela, which also earned seven points but finished with an inferior goal difference. Now, the Rojiblancos on national team duty are preparing for a new challenge at the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026, as Mexico will face Argentina in the Round of 32 on Monday, November 30, looking to book a place in the Round of 16. item.title: It’s time for Cowboys to fire Brian Schottenheimer after unthinkable Thanksgiving meltdown vs. Eagles
item.description: Kevin Jairaj-Imagn Images It’s time for Cowboys to fire Brian Schottenheimer after unthinkable Thanksgiving meltdown vs. Eagles appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . It’s still hard to imagine the unfathomable loss that the Dallas Cowboys experienced on Thanksgiving Day. But owner Jerry Jones stood behind coach Brian Schottenheimer . However, it is time for the Cowboys to fire Schottenheimer after the unthinkable meltdown against the Eagles. When Brandon Aubrey kicked a field goal with 3:35 remaining in the third quarter, the Cowboys led 31-10. Finishing seemed like a foregone conclusion. But what happened in the final 18 minutes of the game lands on the accountability desk of Schottenheimer. The ease of the Eagles scoring A team with a commanding late second-half lead simply can’t allow big plays or short scoring drives. It’s coaching-from-the-couch level of knowledge. You play deep safeties and make the other team eat clock when they have the ball. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Here’s what transpired after the Cowboys took the 21-point lead: — Eagles six plays, 80 yards, TD — Cowboys 3-and out because they got stuffed on 3rd and 1 run. Blocked punt, TD — Cowboys 7-play TD drive — Eagles 55-yard kickoff return; 3 plays, 42 yards, TD — Cowboys 3 and out (trick play fails on illegal forward pass, loss of down); 23-yard return on punt — Eagles 3 plays, interception — Cowboys miss 40-yard field goal — Eagles 4 plays, 70 yards, TD — Cowboys suffer sack on 4th and 1 play — Eagles 6 plays, 11 yards, FG — Cowboys throw INT on final play When you go through those things, you see a total team meltdown. The Cowboys’ special teams basically checked out of AT&T Stadium at the end of the third quarter. It’s hard to imagine they could have played any worse. Blocked punt, missed field goal, two huge kick returns allowed. Disaster. And the offense went into a shell. Keep in mind the Eagles had been playing without All-Pro defensive back Cooper DeJean since the first quarter. But the Cowboys somehow got gummed up on offense. And the defense? Just abysmal again Over the last five weeks, the Cowboys have played the Cardinals, Colts, 49ers, Titans, and Eagles. Take out the 49ers and those other teams have a combined record of 11-32. Even with the 49ers, it’s a 20-33 mark. And yet the Cowboys have surrendered 33, 23, 46, 30, and 39 points. The defense has been awful. But talented, right? Tackle Quinnen Williams is playing like a beast. The pass rush has racked up five sacks in four of its last five games. Caleb Downs looks like the real deal at safety. Joey Porter Jr. is a lockdown cornerback. So the ball lands squarely in the court of Schottenheimer. And that’s why change needs to be made. Not to save this season, but to restore some overall order. item.title: Sophie Cunningham flexes gym return amid WNBA future uncertainty
item.description: One of the most popular WNBA players will be an unrestricted free agent this offseason, when Sophie Cunningham hits the open market after spending two years with the Indiana Fever . While her future in the league is currently uncertain, she’s been making the most of her free time since the 2026 campaign ended and the offseason began. We’ve seen Cunningham popping up at several high-profile events, while recently landing the cover of Maxim magazine in a revealing photoshoot and cover story . Because of her popularity skyrocketing over the past year, we’ve also seen Cunningham “nominated” to be the next Bond girl . Cunningham has also been the subject of some bizarre on-air segments on FOX News , while sharing her thoughts on a variety of topics on her podcast, No Hesitation , with co-host Drew Hanlen. But now, she’s back in the gym and ready to put in some work. MORE: Sophie Cunningham stuns in Bond girl-inspired fit for F1 Las Vegas Grand Prix Fan Favorite Sophie Cunningham Gearing Up For Free Agency Instagram/Sophie Cunningham It’s going to be interesting to see what type of market is out there for Cunningham. She is a strong contributor off the bench and does bring intensity, but her off-court distractions could make some teams hesitant. With the league growing, there’s no time for side shows, and it’s no secret that Cunningham will unapologetically be herself, you just have to wonder what team will find a spot for her in the rotation. MORE: Sophie Cunningham nearly turned down viral Maxim cover shoot over misunderstanding WNBA free agency negotiations can begin on February 4, 2027, before the official contract signings are allowed to become official on February 16. We’ll have to see whether a return to the Fever is in the cards, or whether the wildly popular free agent finds a new home. Last season, Cunningham averaged 7.9 points, 2.3 rebounds, and 1.2 assists in 22.2 minutes per game in 43 appearances, with three starts. item.title: Flavio Briatore Got Rich on Benetton’s US Boom—Then Saw His First Grand Prix in 1988
item.description: Flavio Briatore was already wealthy from Benetton’s American franchise boom when he watched his first Formula 1 race, in Adelaide in November 1988. He went on to run a championship-winning team, get banned from the sport and come back. But the money came first, and it came from selling sweaters in America. How Benetton’s American Boom Made Briatore Rich Benetton, the Italian knitwear brand, opened its first five stores in the United States in 1979. Within about three years, Briatore was the Benetton Group’s main representative in the country. His job was to sign up the people who opened the shops. By one account, he took a percentage of every deal he arranged , and he did a lot of them. Benetton had 800 stores in North America by 1988. The boom didn’t last. Store owners complained about rival Benetton shops opening nearby, and the North American count later fell to about 200. By then, Briatore had moved on. Luciano Benetton, whose family had put its name on an F1 team in 1986, sent him to the Australian Grand Prix. Briatore had said he had no interest in the sport. After that race, he was made commercial director of Benetton Formula. He didn’t stay on the commercial side for long. Briatore pushed out the old management and ended up running the whole team. In 1991, he signed a 22-year-old Michael Schumacher after just one race for Jordan. Flavio Briatore (right) with Tom Walkinshaw at the 1993 British Grand Prix. Image Credit: Martin Lee / Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0) From Schumacher’s Titles to Alpine Schumacher won the drivers’ championship for Benetton in 1994 and 1995, and the team took the 1995 constructors’ title. Briatore was replaced as team boss in 1997 and sold his shares. By his own account, the team wasn’t worth much by today’s standards. “I sold my share in Benetton, and the value of the team was $80million,” he told The Race this year. He put the same team’s value now at $3.5 billion to $4 billion. He came back when Renault bought the team, which raced as Renault from 2002. Fernando Alonso won the drivers’ title in 2005 and 2006, and Renault took the constructors’ crown both years. Then came Singapore. In September 2009, the FIA banned Briatore indefinitely after finding that Nelson Piquet Jr. had crashed on purpose in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix to help Alonso win. In January 2010, a Paris court overturned the ban, ruling the FIA’s process had been flawed without ruling on the crash itself. Away from racing, he had already built a second business. Briatore started the Billionaire brand of nightclubs and fashion in 1998. He returned to Enstone, now home to Alpine, as an executive advisor in 2024. When team principal Oliver Oakes resigned in May 2025, Briatore took on his duties. His official title is still executive advisor, but he runs the team.

item.title: Week 12 Fantasy Football Must-Start Sleepers: Chris Rodriguez, DeShaun Watson, And More
item.description: Jacksonville Jaguars running back Chris Rodriguez Jr. (24) runs the ball against the Indianapolis Colts at EverBank Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Travis Register-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect Every week, fantasy owners look at those fringe players on their bench and aren't quite sure if they should insert them into their starting lineups or leave them on the bench. Those are the toughest decisions to make. That's why we are here to help you make those tough decisions on those sleepers. These are our fringe players to get into your lineups in Week 12. Must-Start Sleepers: Week 12 QB Deshaun Watson, Cleveland Browns Watson has quietly been playing pretty well, throwing for more than 300 yards in three consecutive games. The issue is he hasn't thrown a single touchdown during that span. However, he has rushed for 70 yards and two touchdowns during that span. If he can start throwing some more touchdowns, he can suddenly become a highly productive fantasy quarterback. Week 12 is an ideal time to break out against the Las Vegas Raiders. The Raiders are allowing the seventh-most fantasy points to quarterbacks this season, and they entered the week even worse, but there have already been a ton of points scored this week. RB Chris Rodriguez, Jacksonville Jaguars It doesn't look like Bhayshul Tuten is likely to play this week, and even if he does, we don't expect him to get close to a full workload. The Jaguars play the Tennessee Titans this week in a game that they should win comfortably with or without him, and the coaching staff has expressed a need to get him healthy, as he has struggled through an ankle injury for weeks. This should open up a ton of opportunities for Rodriguez in a favorable matchup in what should be a positive game script. Rodriguez is an intriguing option even if Tuten is active, but he's a strong sleeper if Tuten is sidelined. WR Caleb Douglas, Miami Dolphins The rookie had a rough game last week, catching just two of his 10 targets for 30 yards with a bunch of drops. Nevertheless, we wouldn't be giving up on a rising young star like Douglas. We are going to look at the positives and point out the fact that he was open all game and saw 10 targets. He should bounce back this week against the lowly Jets, whom he caught two touchdowns against in the Dolphins' only win this season. TE Chig Okonkwo, Washington Commanders All the pieces for Okonkwo to be successful have been there this season; he just hasn't quite put them all together. This week he draws the Arizona Cardinals, who are allowing the third-most fantasy points to tight ends this season. We have seen the targets be there and the yardage at times, this is the week that he's going to find the end zone and step up as a TE1. item.title: Why Aaron Rodgers isn’t playing in Week 12 & Steelers-McCarthy controversy explained
item.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers have a new quarterback under center for the Week 12 game against the Denver Broncos after the team decided to move off of Aaron Rodgers to Mason Rudolph. It was a decision that the Steelers made late on Tuesday night , and after that Rodgers went full scorched Earth on head coach Mike McCarthy on Wednesday, which led to the Steelers cutting Rodgers not long after that. Here’s more details about one of the wildest situations we’ve ever seen in the history of the NFL. Aaron Rodgers-Mike McCarthy controversy explained Pittsburgh Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy talks with quarterback Aaron Rodgers during warms up for a game against the New York Jets at Acrisure Stadium. Credit: Barry Reeger-Imagn Images via Reuters Connect (Reuters) Seemingly out of nowhere, McCarthy decided to make a change at quarterback on Tuesday night, which caught the entire NFL world off guard. Then, on Wednesday, Rodgers went on “The Pat McAfee Show” and fired off a whole host of allegations about McCarthy, with the now-former Steelers quarterback saying McCarthy was falling asleep in meetings, missing meetings and walkthroughs, and even breaking the Steelers down by saying the wrong team name. “Mike McCarthy broke down the Steelers saying 1, 2, 3 Packers,” Rodgers said. MORE: Tomlin sounds off on ‘dumpster fire’ amid Rodgers-McCarthy fiasco It was an incredibly embarrassing situation, not only for McCarthy, but for a revered franchise like the Steelers that isn’t used to this kind of dysfunction. Why Steelers cut Aaron Rodgers Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers (8) reacts after the game at Lincoln Financial Field. Credit: Eric Hartline-Imagn Images via Reuters Connect (Reuters) After Rodgers aired all of McCarthy’s dirty laundry that has since been corroborated by several reports , the Steelers had no choice but to cut ties with the veteran quarterback. “I am disappointed in where this went with Aaron Rodgers, but I have 100% confidence in Mike McCarthy,” Steelers owner Art Rooney II said in his statement after Rodgers’ release, according to the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette’s Gerry Dulac . “Decisions were made on what we believe is in the best interest of the Pittsburgh Steelers. item.description: Credit: Lon Horwedel-Imagn Images Best fantasy football TE replacements with Colston Loveland dealing with knee injury appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Fantasy football managers who roster Colston Loveland are suddenly facing a tough decision at the tight end position. The Bears tight end is expected to land on injured reserve after suffering a knee injury in Chicago’s Thanksgiving matchup against the Detroit Lions. While there is still hope he can return later this season, managers should prepare for the possibility of being without their starting tight end for the remainder of the fantasy football playoffs. The timing could not be worse. The fantasy playoffs are only a few weeks away, making Weeks 12 and 13 crucial for managers trying to secure a spot or improve their position. Unfortunately, there is not much fantasy managers can do to replace Loveland in Week 12, but looking ahead to Week 13 is a different story. Here are four tight ends worth targeting on the waiver wire who could help fill the void in your lineup. item.title: Nigeria set to bid to host maiden U-17 WAFCON
item.description: By Enitan Abdultawab Nigeria is preparing to bid to host the maiden edition of the Under-17 Women’s Africa Cup of Nations (WAFCON), as the country seeks to attract more international sporting competitions and strengthen its sports economy. The Director-General of the National Sports Commission (NSC), Bukola Olopade, disclosed this in a video shared on his X handle on Friday, saying Nigeria had already communicated its interest to the Confederation of African Football (CAF). According to Olopade, the country expressed its desire to host the competition during CAF’s General Assembly held in Abuja last weekend. “We have said to CAF that we are desirous of hosting the first Under-17 women’s championship,” he said. He explained that the move forms part of Nigeria’s ambition to move away from what he described as a consuming sports economy towards a productive one, where hosting international events would generate economic benefits for the country. “We don’t want to be a consuming sports economy; rather, we want to be a productive sports economy. We want to attract more international events where the economic impacts will be felt by the people,” Olopade added. CAF’s Executive Committee approved the introduction of the U-17 WAFCON on November 21, with the inaugural tournament scheduled to take place between March and April 2028. Qualifying matches are expected to begin in April 2027. Nigeria’s interest in hosting the competition comes amid discussions about the country’s readiness to stage major international football events. Earlier this week, FIFA President Gianni Infantino said Nigeria was not yet ready to host the men’s FIFA World Cup, although he acknowledged the country’s resources, passion and willingness to stage the competition. Infantino, however, suggested that Nigeria could demonstrate its organisational capacity by hosting smaller international football tournaments before taking on events of greater magnitude. The proposed U-17 WAFCON could therefore provide Nigeria with an opportunity to showcase its capacity to organise a continental football competition. The post Nigeria set to bid to host maiden U-17 WAFCON appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: 2. Bundesliga: Bochum sink travel-sick Darmstadt with late goals
item.description: 2. Bundesliga: Bochum sink travel-sick Darmstadt with late goals Bochum scored two late goals against Darmstadt to secure back-to-back home wins in 2. Bundesliga. The visitors lost all of their first six away games in the division. Both sides struggled for goals so far this season, and that was visible from the lack of clear-cut chances for the large part of the game. The hosts had the best opportunity of the first 45 minutes when the right fullback Klaiber hit the crossbar with a solo effort. Timo Horn was called into action late in the half as the ex-Köln shot-stopper made a couple of decent stops. The returnee Marcel Schuhen made his first save of the game early after the restart to deny Koji Miyoshi. The two goalkeepers continued on their excellent form by stopping Christian Rasmussen and Milan Smit from breaking the deadlock. When the deciding goal finally came, Schuhen was well beaten, however. Philipp Hofmann scored yet another headed goal from an inviting cross by substitute Berkan Taz. The former Karlsruhe man is only a goal shy of the top of the scoring chart at the age of 33. He also helped Uwe Rösler's side reach the Round of 16 in the DFB-Pokal with goals against his former club Greuther Fürth and Mainz. Darmstadt searched for a late equalizer as Schuhen joined to attack a set-piece opportunity, but that led to the second goal in the last action of the game. Taz finally grabbed his first Bochum goal with an open goal at his mercy in what was an exciting finish to a lifeless encounter for the most part. Darmstadt are still waiting for their first point away from home after competing for promotion the previous campaign. Bochum will host Augsburg on Wednesday in the DFB-Pokal before their last away game of the year next weekend in Nürnberg. Rösler's men momentarily climbed to eighth, while Darmstadt will spend another week in the relegation zone. Florian Kohfeldt's troops face Bundesliga's basement club Borussia Mönchengladbach in the DFB-Pokal Round of 16 tie.

item.title: DeWine, Whitmer make wager on Ohio State-Michigan game
item.description: With hopes of a national championship dashed, the Ohio State University Buckeyes are playing for pride and a place in The Game's history against their rival, the Michigan Wolverines . Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine is playing for sweet treats in a wager made with Michigan Gov. Gretchen Whitmer. For the bet, DeWine is offering a box of Ohio-made food and treats from the state Department of Agriculture. The "Ohio Proud Holiday Gift Box" includes chocolate buckeyes from Marsha's Buckeyes in Perrysburg, apple maple BBQ sauce from Hays Orchard & Cider Mill in Columbiana and holiday roast coffee from SGT Coffee Co. in Gahanna. The greatest rivalry in college football is al❌ost here, so it's ti❌e for our yearly wager, Governor Whit❌er!🏈 I’❌ so confident Ohio State will win on Saturday, I'm putting an Ohio Proud Holiday Box fro❌ @ohioagriculture on the line! It's full of Ohio products fro❌ places… pic.twitter.com/pn66N3R6V4 — Governor Mike DeWine (@GovMikeDeWine) November 25, 2026 The holiday boxes have already sold out for 2026, but Ohio Proud lists the products included if Ohioans want to shop local or build their own. Whitmer is wagering a basket of Michigan cherry goodies. Michigan is known for its tart cherries. The state grows about 70% of the United States’ supply . You’re on, @GovMikeDeWine and I can’t wait for the Wolverines to bring home another W. I’ll wager a basket of Michigan cherry goodies. Go blue! https://t.co/Ug6Ndpdxit — Governor Gretchen Whitmer (@GovWhitmer) November 27, 2026 DeWine's record in Ohio State-Michigan bets is dismal, with the Buckeyes going 2-4 during his time as governor. (One rivalry game was canceled in 2020 because of the COVID-19 pandemic.) The Buckeyes have had a disappointing season by their standards, going 7-4 after being ranked preseason No. 1. They won't make the College Football Playoff and face a seemingly impossible path to make a Big Ten championship. True freshman quarterback Luke Fahey had to step in for veteran Julian Sayin after Sayin's season-ending injury in the Indiana game on Oct. 17. But DeWine and the Buckeyes have a shot at redemption at noon on Nov. 28, a chance to go out the right way. Star receiver Jeremiah Smith, widely considered the best player in college football, is still chasing post-season honors, including the Biletnikoff and Heisman trophies. Meanwhile, DeWine and Whitmer are wrapping up their eight-year terms as governor. Gov.-elect Amy Acton is set to be sworn in as Ohio's first elected female governor on Jan. 11. She's also the first Democrat to hold the role in 16 years. Michigan Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson will replace Whitmer as its next governor. State government reporter Jessie Balmert can be reached at jbalmert@usatodayco.com or @jbalmert on X. This article originally appeared on The Columbus Dispatch: DeWine, Whitmer make wager on Ohio State-Michigan game

item.title: Brian Schottenheimer reveals what was discussed in Cowboys’ meeting with Jerry Jones, Stephen Jones after Eagles loss
item.description: Eric Hartline-Imagn Images Brian Schottenheimer reveals what was discussed in Cowboys’ meeting with Jerry Jones, Stephen Jones after Eagles loss appeared first on ClutchPoints . Dallas Cowboys head coach Brian Schottenheimer revealed that disappointment and a desire to quickly move forward highlighted his postgame conversation with owner Jerry Jones and executive vice president Stephen Jones following the team’s stunning Thanksgiving collapse against the Philadelphia Eagles . Dallas appeared to have control of Thursday’s divisional matchup after building a 31-10 lead. However, the Cowboys failed to protect the 21-point advantage and ultimately suffered a 39-38 loss , dropping them to 5-7 on the season. The Athletic’s Jon Machota shared Schottenheimer’s comments Friday via X, formerly known as Twitter. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) “Cowboys coach Brian Schottenheimer said he talked to Jerry Jones and Stephen Jones after the game last night,” Machota wrote. “Our conversations were shared disappointment, but we’re also ready to get back to work,” Schottenheimer said. Brian Schottenheimer, Cowboys look to move forward after historic collapse The loss added another frustrating result to a season that has featured multiple collapses for Dallas. Defensive struggles have remained one of the Cowboys’ biggest problems, and they resurfaced in dramatic fashion against Philadelphia. After Dallas established its 31-10 advantage, the Eagles stormed back and scored 29 points as the Cowboys watched what appeared to be a commanding lead disappear. Schottenheimer’s meeting with Jerry Jones and Stephen Jones reflected the frustration surrounding the result, but his comments also indicated that the organization is turning its attention toward its next opportunity. The Cowboys have little margin for error at 5-7 as they attempt to remain in the postseason picture during the final stretch of the regular season. Dallas will have an opportunity to respond when it faces the Seattle Seahawks in Week 13 . The 6-4 Seahawks will host the Cowboys on Monday Night Football at 8:15 p.m. ET on ESPN and ABC. item.title: White Sox Ignore Miguel Vargas Amid All-Star Form
item.description: David Richard-Imagn Images Miguel Vargas just put up an All-Star season, but the White Sox have not made a single move to extend his contract. While other clubs are locking up their core, Chicago seems content to wait. The delay comes right as Vargas becomes arbitration eligible. According to MLB Trade Rumors , a long-term deal does not appear to be on the White Sox’s radar at all. Timing the Lockout The front office has a clear reason for holding off, even if it feels risky to fans. Contract extensions are typically not discussed or finalized by clubs until the offseason concludes. James Fegan of the Chicago Sun-Times observes that the White Sox seem focused on outside acquisitions prior to the lockout instead of retaining internal talent. Since Vargas has three years of team control left, there is no urgent need to secure him right away. He is set to hit free agency following the 2029 season, which gives the organization plenty of time. For the infielder’s initial arbitration hearing, MLBTR contributor Matt Swartz estimated a $5.4 million salary. That number reflects his recent performance, yet the team remains quiet on a bigger commitment. Vargas Stays Focused The player himself has taken the high road despite the lack of official talks. Vargas suggested to James Fegan that talks between the two parties have apparently not started yet. Vargas stated: “Contracts or anything like that, I don’t want it to be a distraction for me. I’m very excited for what is coming for me and my future on the South Side. Hopefully I can stay there for many more years.” The player, aware his worth is rising, has taken a stance. Before being traded to the White Sox in a three-team deal, Vargas was a top prospect within the Dodgers’ farm system. The White Sox have not discussed an extension with Miguel Vargas, even though he had a breakout year.

item.title: Unusual Mikey Moore loan clause could save Cologne €1.5m
item.description: Unusual Mikey Moore loan clause could save Cologne €1.5m FC Cologne could end up paying virtually nothing in loan fees for Tottenham Hotspur attacker Mikey Moore thanks to an unusual clause in the 19-year-old’s agreement. According to a report appearing in the Wednesday print edition of Sport Bild , the Bundesliga club’s financial obligations decrease considerably depending on how frequently the English youngster features for René Wagner’s team. Moore’s season-long loan could theoretically cost Cologne as much as €1.5 million in loan fees. The agreement nevertheless contains a provision that reduces the fee with each qualifying appearance. Should Moore make 28 competitive appearances featuring at least 45 minutes on the pitch, the payment to Tottenham would drop to its lowest possible level. Cologne would then effectively be responsible only for the player’s wages. As of Wednesday, November 25, Moore had already accumulated eight appearances meeting the required playing-time threshold. Tottenham retain long-term control over Mikey Moore’s future The arrangement provides an obvious incentive for Cologne to continue giving Moore regular playing time, while Tottenham stand to benefit from the youngster gaining valuable Bundesliga experience. Cologne did not negotiate a purchase option as part of the agreement. Tottenham reportedly intend to incorporate the England youth international into their first-team plans for the 2027/28 campaign. The latest revelations also offer additional context to recent speculation concerning a possible premature termination of Moore’s loan . Cologne sporting director Thomas Kessler and head coach René Wagner have consistently emphasized their confidence in the youngster despite his initial difficulties adapting to German football. That patience finally began to pay dividends last Friday when Moore scored his first Bundesliga goal in Cologne’s impressive 1-1 draw against Bayern Munich. The teenager rounded goalkeeper Jonas Urbig after combining with Said El Mala to give the visitors an early lead. Moore subsequently spoke of his relief at ending his wait for a Bundesliga goal , while El Mala expressed optimism about the pair’s developing attacking partnership . With Moore showing signs of improvement, the financial structure of his loan offers Cologne another reason to continue investing in his development. Tottenham, meanwhile, stand to regain a more experienced player next summer without having surrendered control over his long-term future. GGFN | Peter Weis

item.title: Miami Faces Huge Challenge Against Boston College On Saturday
item.description: Credit: Sam Navarro-Imagn Images The College Football Playoff picture for Miami looks clear, but the road to get there gets rough this weekend. Ranked No. 7 in the latest standings, the Hurricanes occupy a position that feels positive yet guarantees no bye. Per Canes Warning , the team would host BYU in the opening round if the bracket holds, which means every point in the regular season still counts. Miami needs to keep winning to avoid a tough draw that could end their title hopes early. The pressure is real, and the next opponent is a team that simply cannot afford to lose. Boston College Needs a Win That opponent is Boston College, and the Eagles are in a desperate spot. With a 5-6 record, they must defeat the Canes to remain in contention for a bowl game. A loss drops them out of contention entirely, which makes the stakes incredibly high for the visitors. Bill O’Brien, the BC head coach, recognizes the massive task ahead. The Eagles have nothing to lose, which makes them dangerous. Depth Matters for Miami Miami has the talent to handle this pressure, but they cannot take anyone for granted. Following a victory where Virginia Tech was held to 20 points, the Hurricanes demonstrated a defense capable of shutting down a running attack. Mark Fletcher Jr. In that game, three touchdowns were scored to lead the rushing attack, proving the offense has multiple ways to score. Over the long season, Mario Cristobal observes the depth his team has built. “And I look around the country and I see so many top 10, 12, 15 teams on a weekly basis,” Mario Cristobal said about his team and its depth. Heading into the ACC Championship Game against Wake Forest, that depth matters significantly. The history between these two programs favors Miami heavily. The all-time series stands 25-6 in favor of Miami against the Eagles, a record indicating the Canes usually dominate this matchup. To have a chance, Boston College must stop that run game. On Saturday, Nov. 28, the contest occurs at Hard Rock Stadium in Miami Gardens.

item.title: NBC removed polarizing Deshaun Watson from promo hyping Browns-Raiders ‘SNF’ clash
item.description: Raiders-Browns On second thought, NBC doesn’t really feel the need to use Deshaun Watson for promotional ads for this week’s “Sunday Night Football” clash. After previously using the polarizing Browns quarterback with a checkered past to promote this Sunday’s Raiders-Browns game in Cleveland, NBC removed Watson from its video package promoting the game and instead went with linebacker Carson Schwesinger, as noted by Ari Meirov . He tweeted a collage showing last Sunday’s promo featuring Watson alongside Raiders rookie quarterback Fernando Mendoza, compared to Thursday’s version absent Watson. NBC took Deshaun Watson off their promotional graphic for the Browns-Raiders SNF game. Picture 1: Promotional graphic from Sunday night Picture 2: Promotional graphic tonight. pic.twitter.com/l6qDvPpNSh — Ari Meirov (@MySportsUpdate) November 27, 2026 It’s certainly a notable omission due to Watson’s transgressions. Watson faced 27 civil lawsuits alleging misconduct , including allegations of him exposing himself, touching them with his privates and kissing them without consent. The NFL suspended him 11 games in 2022 and fined him $5 million over the allegations ahead of his first season with the Browns. How the NFL media has covered Watson has since become a hot topic, with some getting called out for glossing over the topic. Prime Video’s Al Michaels drew criticism earlier this year for not discussing the topic during a Steelers-Browns “Thursday Night Football clash.” “If you follow football, you know the story — we don’t have to go through the whole Deshaun Watson thing,” Michaels said . Cleveland Browns quarterback Deshaun Watson (4) celebrates after an NFL football game against the Houston Texans in Cleveland, Sunday, Nov. 15, 2026. AP Photo/Sue Ogrocki While replacing a quarterback for another star player in a promo graphic is not unheard of, it stands out in this game since Schwesinger is not a household name. The second-year linebacker is having a strong season for the upstart Browns, yet he’s not a well-known star like Aaron Donald or Micah Parsons. NBC is airing this game since the original Sunday night game featuring the Patriots and Chargers holds the entertainment value of watching grass grow. Houston Texans wide receiver Nico Collins (12) is tackled by Cleveland Browns linebacker Carson Schwesinger (49) on Sunday, Nov. 15, 2026, in Cleveland. IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect The Patriots’ season may be over with Drake Maye possibly sidelined for the year and the Chargers are 1-9 and may be without quarterback Justin Herbert. The league then instead flexed to this matchup featuring a pleasant surprise in Cleveland, which currently owns a playoff spot, against the 2026 No. 1 pick in Mendoza. Even if NBC doesn’t use Watson in the promotional material, his troubling past is a storyline that Mike Tirico and Cris Collinsworth will decide how to address.

item.title: Vikings Starters Missing in Action Again Friday
item.description: Kirby Lee-Imagn Images via Reuters Connect Friday was the Minnesota Vikings’ last full practice before the Atlanta Falcons come to town, and their final chance this week to get two starters back on the field at U.S. Bank Stadium. Left tackle Christian Darrisaw (shoulder) and cornerback Isaiah Rodgers (thigh) were listed as non-participants in both Wednesday’s walkthrough and Thursday’s practice . That left the 7-3 Vikings waiting to see whether either could ramp up before the end of the week. Minnesota Vikings starters missing again Friday Kevin Seifert (ESPN) said earlier Friday that he was seeking clarity on both players, then tweeted out early this afternoon that neither Darrisaw or Rodgers was on the practice field when he was watching practice at TCO Performance Center Friday. However, he also saw Ryan Van Demark warm up at left tackle with the starters. At Vikings practice on Friday: did not see Christian Darrisaw, Isaiah Rodgers or Jordan Addison at portion open to reporters. Doesn't mean they won't practice to some extent, but Ryan Van Demark warmed up at left tackle w/ the starters. — Andrew Krammer (@andrewkrammer.bsky.social) 2026-11-27T18:47:27.741Z Who fills in for Christian Darrisaw and Isaiah Rodgers? item.title: 3 free agents Yankees must sign before expected MLB lockout
item.description: Brad Penner-Imagn Images 3 free agents Yankees must sign before expected MLB lockout appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The New York Yankees have been a consistent contender in recent years. Finding a way to win their first World Series championship since 2009 has proven to be a challenge, however. There are three available free agents who could help the Yankees take a big step toward returning to their championship-winning ways. It is worth mentioning that the Yankees have already upgraded their bullpen this offseason. In addition to David Bednar accepting his qualifying offer and returning, the Yankees have signed a number of relievers including Jonathan Loaisiga . Nevertheless, further improving the bullpen remains an option. Addressing the lineup should be a goal as well. Without further ado, here are three free agents the Yankees must sign before the upcoming expected MLB lockout — which is set to begin in early December. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) LHP Adrian Morejon The Yankees are rumored to be interested in Morejon despite already bringing in a number of relievers. Rumors have suggested that Morejon could return to the starting rotation. He made starts early in his career but has since become one of the best setup men in the sport. He pitched to exactly a 2.83 ERA in 2024 and 2026 out of the bullpen with the San Diego Padres. In 2025, the southpaw had a 2.08 ERA in his relief appearances. Bringing him in as a reliever makes more sense for the Yankees since their starting rotation is already quite strong. Although, having Morejon start wouldn’t be an issue either. In any case, signing Morejon would give the Yankees’ pitching staff a crucial boost regardless of his role. Carson Kelly, catcher The Yankees have been mentioned as a trade suitor for a number of potentially available catchers. Kelly doesn’t offer the same upside as some of those catchers, but he’s a proven veteran who would give New York a right-handed option alongside the left-handed hitting Austin Wells. Kelly spent the 2026 campaign with the Chicago Cubs. He hit .258 with a .713 OPS. Wells, meanwhile, hit just .186 with a .624 OPS. Whether or not the Yankees decide to go with a platoon, Kelly would represent an upgrade against left-handed pitching at the very least. Kelly likely would come at a reasonable price in free agency. He’s not a star player by any means. Still, he’s more than capable of making an impact. The Yankees can continue to monitor the trade market, but Kelly is a nice alternative in MLB free agency. Mauricio Dubon, infielder Dubon’s mention in this story may come as a surprise. Nevertheless, he’s a three-time Gold Glove winner who would give the Yankees a versatile player. Ryan McMahon is New York’s current third baseman. He bats left-handed, so Dubon could get at-bats against lefties. item.title: Real Madrid superstar fully focused on club, nothing to recent PSG links – Romano
item.description: Real Madrid superstar fully focused on club, nothing to recent PSG links – Romano In a key update, transfer expert Fabrizio Romano has shut down recent rumours linking Real Madrid megastar Vinicius Jr. to PSG. The Brazilian superstar has endured a difficult start to the new season at the Santiago Bernabeu. With his position as a guaranteed starter under threat, a move to PSG was touted, especially with the Parisians losing two key players to injury. Vinicius not going anywhere Having signed a new long-term contract at Real Madrid in the summer, Vinicius has failed to perform at the level expected of him this season. His poor form, coupled with an extended absence in La Liga due to a four-match suspension, paved the way for Yan Diomande to stake a claim for a regular starting berth. Not thinking about PSG. (Photo by Angel Martinez/Getty Images) The 20-year-old Ivory Coast international has done just that, delivering impressive performances for Los Blancos , leading to Vinicius’ spot in the team coming under threat. PSG, who have recently lost two key attackers – Khvicha Kvaratskhelia and Desire Doue – to ACL injuries, are on the lookout for a new wide player to strengthen their ranks. Given Vinicius’ current predicament at the Santiago Bernabeu, speculations arose about the reigning French and European champions weighing up a move for him in the immediate future. However, as clarified by Fabrizio Romano, there is absolutely nothing to the rumours linking the Brazilian attacker to Luis Enrique’s side. Vinicius fully focused on Real Madrid The Italian transfer expert further goes on to add that despite the current situation, Vinicius remains fully committed to and focused on doing well at Real Madrid. Fully focused on Real Madrid. (Photo by Diego Souto/Getty Images) And, of late, there have been some positive signs with regard to the 26-year-old winger’s form. Vinicius scored five goals in two games for Brazil during the international break earlier this month. Following that, he helped create a goal for Real Madrid in their 2-1 win over Celta Vigo in La Liga. Earlier this week, the Real Madrid No. 7 found the back of the net in the team’s 5-1 win over PSV Eindhoven in the UEFA Champions League. In all, Vinicius has made 14 appearances for Real Madrid this term, scoring two and assisting three goals. With Jose Mourinho and the rest of the squad rallying around him , it could be only a matter of time before he returns to his best.

item.title: SMAT: Shreyas Iyer to turn out for Mumbai in super league; SKY to continue as captain
item.description: MUMBAI: In a big boost to Mumbai, India's T20 captain Shreyas Iyer will join the team for the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy Super League matches in Nagpur, TOI has exclusively learnt. However, India's 2026 T20 World Cup-winning captain Suryakumar Yadav, who led Mumbai in the league stage, will continue as the Mumbai captain for the Super League. In fact, with all-rounders Suryansh Shedge (it's understood that Shedge will be available from the second match) and Tanush Kotian also set to be available after India A's campaign in the Rising Stars Asia Cup in Doha ended on Thursday with their defeat against Sri Lanka A in the semi-finals, Mumbai will be at full strength for the Super League stage of the SMAT. Under Surya's captaincy, Mumbai remained unbeaten in the league phase, winning six out of their seven matches in Kolkata to collect 26 points, while the seventh game was washed out. With 214 runs in six matches at 53.50 and a strike rate of 230, including two fifties, SKY was Mumbai's second-highest run-getter and showed signs of returning to form. Iyer last featured in the white-ball series against New Zealand in October, comprising five T20Is followed by five ODIs, and did not enjoy great form. He scored 126 runs in five T20Is at 25.20, with a strike rate of 151.80, and just 86 runs in the ODIs at 16.75, without scoring a fifty. The 31-year-old will thus get to play and get some runs under his belt in three, and possibly four if Mumbai make it to the final, matches in the SMAT Super League stage before turning out for India in the three-match home ODI series against Sri Lanka, starting December 13 in Visakhapatnam. He is India's ODI vice-captain. Kotian played just one match, against Sri Lanka in the semi-final of the Asia Cup Rising Stars, in which he scored 28 and conceded 48 runs without taking a wicket in six overs. Shedge was out for 10 and conceded 23 runs without taking a wicket in two overs. Overall, Shedge scored 49 runs in four matches at 24.50 and took three wickets in four matches at 42.00. Eight teams have made it to the Super League, which will begin on November 30. Mumbai have been placed in Super League B (Group 2) alongside Rajasthan, Punjab and Andhra. Mumbai will play their opening match against Andhra at the Civil Lines Stadium in Nagpur on November 30, from 1:30 pm. On December 2, the 2022 and 2024-25 champions will next take on Punjab at the Vidarbha Cricket Association Stadium in Jamtha from 4:30 pm. On December 4, Mumbai will play their final match of the Super League against Rajasthan at the VCA Stadium in Civil Lines from 1:30 pm. There will be no semi-finals in the Super League, with the group toppers clashing in the final on December 6.

item.title: Patriots rooting guide for Thanksgiving weekend
item.description: Happy Thanksgiving weekend, everybody. While the rest of us are going to enjoy some days with family and food, the NFL is quite busy: a total of 16 games will be played between Wednesday and Monday, with at least one game on on five of the next six days. One of those will be played by the New England Patriots, who are going to take on the Los Angeles Chargers on Sunday at 4:05 p.m. ET. There are no questions about who to root for in this specific game, but how about the others? Let’s take a look. Once again, a quick explainer: as long as the Patriots are still theoretically alive in the race for a playoff spot, we will root with that possibility in mind. Friday 3 p.m. ET Denver Broncos (8-2) at Pittsburgh Steelers ( 6-4 ) : Go Broncos! Now this is a game that truly matters. The Steelers are the current seventh seed in the AFC and as such the Patriots’ closest rival in the race for a postseason spot. In fact, if they lose to the Broncos and New England wins in L.A. then the Patriots are suddenly ahead of them in the standings. Luckily for the Patriots, the Steelers are doing their best these days to at least play their part in that. | Prime Video Sunday 1 p.m. ET New Orleans Saints (3-7) at Cincinnati Bengals (7-3) : Go Saints! Somebody has to win the AFC North, and the Bengals are the best bet right now. That said, it would be good if they had to fight for playoff positioning until the very last week of the season, just in case the Patriots need them to beat the Browns in Week 18. With. that in mind, we are rooting for the Saints in this one. | CBS Baltimore Ravens (4-7) at Houston Texans (4-6) : Go Ravens! Another somewhat important game from a Patriots point of view. Neither team is currently in the playoff picture, but the Texans have seemingly started hitting their stride and a loss to the moribund Ravens would help break their momentum and make a late push harder. | CBS New York Giants (6-3-1) at Indianapolis Colts (3-8) : Go Colts! Indianapolis entering the playoff race seems like a long shot, meaning that this can be a game where we root with draft position in mind. Don’t forget: the Jets earn the Colts’ first-rounder next year. | FOX Tennessee Titans (1-9) at Jacksonville Jaguars (7-3) : Go Titans! With games against the Steelers and Texans still on their schedule, the Patriots will want the Jaguars to have to bring their A-game in both contests. Maybe some heat applied from a loss to their division rivals can help with that. | FOX New York Jets (3-8) at Miami Dolphins (1-9) : Go Dolphins! We are rooting for the worse-positioned AFC East team in this one, once again from a draft perspective. | CBS Atlanta Falcons (3-7) at Minnesota Vikings (7-3) : Go Vikings! Four words: strength of schedule tiebreaker. Will it matter? Unlikely. Is it better to be safe than sorry, though? Absolutely. | FOX 4:25 p.m. ET Washington Commanders (4-5-1) at Arizona Cardinals (3-8) : Go Commanders! We would rather see top draft picks end up with an NFC team like

item.title: Hackers breach US Air Force Cloud computing platform
item.description: Hackers have breached Cloud One, the United States Air Force’s flagship cloud computing platform, potentially exposing sensitive military, personnel and logistics data. Three people familiar with the matter told Reuters that the intrusion was discovered within the past month during efforts to upgrade the system, triggering disruptions across the platform. However, the identity of the hackers, the full extent of the breach and whether any data was stolen remain unknown. In a statement to Reuters, the US Air Force declined to discuss the security status of specific networks and systems. It said: “We continuously take prudent measures to protect Department (of the Air Force) information, systems and mission capabilities.” A major military computing platform Launched in 2017, Cloud One was designed as a centralised platform for the Air Force’s information technology needs, bringing together services provided by four major technology companies: Microsoft, Amazon, Oracle and Alphabet. The platform supports dozens of applications, including systems managing personnel records, salaries, logistics and military equipment maintenance. Among the applications hosted on Cloud One are the Air Force’s Cloud-Based Command and Control system, which consolidates air defence radar and other data feeds across North America, and the Theatre Integrated Combat Munitions System, which tracks bombs and missiles at more than 200 US Air Force locations worldwide. Cloud One is regarded as one of the US military’s largest cloud computing platforms, according to two sources familiar with the matter. “A breach here is a big deal,” one of the sources told Reuters. Investigators have reportedly involved US Cyber Command, the military’s cyber warfare arm, to assess the damage. Science Applications International Corporation (SAIC) served as the platform’s prime contractor until 2025, when Leidos took over the contract. SAIC did not respond to Reuters’ request for comment, while Leidos referred questions to the Air Force. Breach disrupts military operations The intrusion has reportedly triggered several disruptions across the platform. Two sources and another person familiar with the matter said plans to migrate additional back-office applications to Cloud One, a longstanding military priority, had been suspended. Updates to applications already running on the platform were also blocked, preventing Air Force personnel from installing fixes, even as new software vulnerabilities were being disclosed across the technology industry. Another source said some users had their administrator privileges revoked. One of the sources said the hackers exploited a software vulnerability to gain access to the platform’s control plane, which manages and oversees the underlying cloud infrastructure. The source likened the control plane to a universal remote, explaining that access could theoretically allow intruders to check the operational status of military aircraft or monitor the movement of spare

item.title: Gavi speaks out on his lack of playing time at Barcelona
item.description: Gavi speaks out on his lack of playing time at Barcelona Barcelona star Gavi has late this week spoken publicly on his lack of playing time across the early months of the new campaign. Midfielder Gavi is of course in the midst of what has been something of a challenging season to date. Sitting behind all of Rodri, Pedri, Frenkie de Jong, Marc Bernal, Fermín López and Dani Olmo in Hansi Flick’s engine room pecking order, the 22-year-old has been afforded just three starts between La Liga and the Champions League. His latest starting berth came in midweek, in Barcelona’s Champions League trip to Azerbaijan to face Sabah. But even against opposition considered altogether inferior to the Blaugrana, Gavi failed to stand out, producing something of a lacklustre showing all told. Speaking during an appearance in front of the media this week, the subject of his ongoing struggles was therefore put to the Spanish international himself. And Gavi produced a mature, measured response, explaining: “That’s what happens when you’re at the best club in the world. Everyone is good, and the coach gives players opportunities when he sees fit.” Conor Laird – GSFN

item.title: Diamondbacks and Pirates Both Win Henry Davis Trade
item.description: The Arizona Diamondbacks are doing some Black Friday shopping today. The team acquired catcher Henry Davis from the Pittsburgh Pirates. In exchange, the Pirates are receiving utilityman Tim Tawa . Player Swap Between Arizona and Pittsburgh Trade news: The Arizona Diamondbacks are acquiring catcher Henry Davis from the Pittsburgh Pirates for utilityman Tim Tawa, sources tell ESPN. Davis, the former No. 1 overall pick, joins Gabriel Moreno while the Pirates get more versatile with Tawa, who can play everywhere. — Jeff Passan (@JeffPassan) November 27, 2026 Davis, 27, appeared in 97 games for the Pirates in 2026. The Bedford native hit 1.72 with 10 home runs and 38 RBI. Tawa, also 27, appeared in 104 games for the Diamondbacks last season. The Oregon native hit .240 with 11 home runs and 42 RBI. Davis’ Role In Arizona Henry Davis joins an Arizona team that has not made the postseason since 2023, the year they went to the World Series. Davis is set to step into the backup role behind Gabriel Moreno. Coming off a Silver Slugger and a Gold Glove , Moreno’s status as the starter is not in jeopardy. Davis will handle Moreno’s routine rest days. He will also likely go behind the plate against tough left-handed pitchers, allowing Moreno to slide into the designated hitter slot. Moreno has dealt with some durability issues in his career, so adding a sturdy option in Davis is a good add for the Diamondbacks. Beyond filling a clear roster opening, acquiring Davis is a smart, low-risk gamble on high-end defensive value and untapped upside. While Henry Davis has struggled significantly at the plate, he has quietly developed into one of baseball’s best defensive catchers—posting +8 Defensive Runs Saved and throwing out nearly 46% of would-be base stealers in 2026. For a Diamondbacks club that prioritizes run prevention and shutting down the running game, Davis immediately stabilizes the catching depth chart without requiring a multi-year free-agent commitment. Smart Deal For Diamondbacks From a roster-building standpoint, the trade makes just as much sense financially and logistically. Arizona dealt from a position of surplus by moving utilityman Tim Tawa, who was blocked on a crowded infield depth chart, in exchange for a former No. 1 overall draft pick who remains under cost-controlled team control through 2029. Even if Davis never finds his offensive footing in the majors, his elite defense and affordable salary make him an ideal backup; if a change of scenery helps unlock even a fraction of his former first-round bat, the Diamondbacks will have pulled off a major bargain. item.title: Vikings predicted to get back on track vs. Falcons after tough 49ers game
item.description: Vikings predicted to get back on track vs. Falcons after tough 49ers game originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . In Week 11, the Minnesota Vikings lost to the San Francisco 49ers in a crushing 35-10 defeat on Sunday Night Football in Mexico City. That loss for the Vikings was a brutal one, as it effectively ended any chance of them securing a first-round bye this season. But they still can win the division and make the playoffs, so the Vikings need to put that game behind them. ESPN's Seth Walder is predicting the Vikings will do just that and more in Week 12 against the Atlanta Falcons . He's predicting the Vikings will shut out Michael Penix Jr. and the Falcons this weekend, getting back on track defensively after a tough Week 11. Vikings predicted to shut out Falcons in Week 12 "The Vikings will shut out the Falcons," Walder predicts. "Fresh off allowing 35 points to the 49ers (granted, that included a pick-six), I expect the Vikings' defense to come storming back to dominate a much-lesser offense in Atlanta." Minnesota's defense is one of the best in the NFL, and they're the kind of unit that could take over a game, shutting things down completely. Walder is predicting that will happen in Week 12 when the Vikings face off against the Falcons. Penix, the Falcons quarterback, struggles against pressure, which the Vikings get more often than any team in the league, with a 46.2% pressure rate. MORE : Solving the Brian Flores puzzle: How Kyle Shanahan finally bested defensive guru in 49ers win Penix might be in serious trouble this week, so long as the Vikings get out to a lead and force the Falcons to throw the ball and not run it with star running back Bijan Robinson. The Vikings haven't shut anyone out this season, and a shutout would be very hard to pull off. But, coming off a tough loss to the 49ers one week ago, and facing a weaker Falcons offense, it wouldn't be that shocking if they shut down the Falcons this week. Even with Atlanta coming out of their Week 11 bye, the Falcons are sure to face a lot of challenges from this Vikings' defense. With their offense also looking better with Kirk Cousins at quarterback, the Vikings have a chance to blow the Falcons out. Walder is predicting the Vikings will get back on track this week with a shutout win over the Falcons, which is a bold prediction, but one that has a real chance of coming true. item.title: Lakers reveal Austin Reaves’ status for NBA Cup matchup vs. Spurs
item.description: SAN ANTONIO — Austin Reaves is making his return to the court for the Lakers’ NBA Cup Group Play matchup against the Spurs at Frost Bank Center. The team upgraded Reaves from questionable to available 7 ½ hours before tipoff on Friday afternoon after the star guard was sidelined for the previous five games because of a bruised left heel. Austin Reaves #15 of the Los Angeles Lakers reacts after a 3-point basket. Getty Images He suffered the injury during the third quarter of their Nov. 11 road win over the Bucks in Milwaukee. The 6-foot-5 star guard was a full participant in the team’s practice on Wednesday before being upgraded to questionable on the Lakers’ Thursday evening status report. Austin Reaves has been sidelined for the last five games. NBAE via Getty Images “It felt good to play basketball again,” Reaves said on Wednesday in his first public comments since the injury. “Wind was a little bad, but kind of to be expected being out two weeks. But felt good.” He wasn’t sure what happened on the play against the Bucks to cause the injury. “I had no idea,” he said. “Tried to play through it, and then I drove baseline, planted on it, and was like, I can’t do this. So walked to the back and was in some pretty bad pain. I didn’t think I broke my foot, but it sure felt like I broke my foot.” The Lakers went 4-1 after Reaves suffered the injury, but the team clearly missed his offensive production. Lakers star guards Luka Doncic (77) and Austin Reaves (15) will have a tough task against the Spurs’ defense. NBAE via Getty Images They had a 112.9 offensive rating (tied for No. 18) in the five games Reaves missed compared to the 121.6 (No. 1) offensive rating in their first 13 games. “Who would have thought that not having an elite offensive player, an All-Star level player would hurt your offense,” coach JJ Redick quipped. “That’s crazy.” Reaves is averaging 24.7 points (51.3% shooting from the field, 40.9% on 3-pointers), 4.7 assists and 3.3 rebounds on the season. “One of those things that just, it sucks,” Reaves said. “I was rolling, playing well. We were rolling as a team, wanted to continue to be out there and play games. Hate missing games. But it’s one of those things, like I said, there wasn’t much that we could really do. But we took care of business.” Austin Reaves (15) of the Los Angeles Lakers shoots a free throw against the Milwaukee Bucks on Wednesday, Nov. 11, 2026, at Fiserv Forum in Milwaukee. NBAE via Getty Images Reaves’ return will give the Lakers a fully healthy roster for the first time since he suffered the injury. Bronny James was the lone player not with the team, with the Lakers assigning the third-year guard to their G League affiliate, the Coachella Valley Lakers.

item.title: Wales aim to finish historic campaign with Japan win
item.description: Japan have beaten Wales twice but never in matches outside of their own country [Getty Images] It is not the traditional ending to a Wales rugby autumn campaign. After the euphoria and then disappointment of two epic international weekends in Cardiff, Wales face the prospect of finishing a November series in south west London with a fixture against Japan. It sounds unusual because the conclusion of the inaugural Nations Championship is exactly that. The concept of a finals weekend in one venue with six games over three days is laudable, but trying to get Welsh fans excited about defeating Japan to finish ninth rather than 10th in a 12-team tournament at a neutral ground is a tough sell, especially when you compare it to what happened in Cardiff two weeks ago. This autumn will always be remembered as the campaign where Wales shocked the rugby world by beating New Zealand for the first time since 1953 . Either side of that momentous day, there has been a lacklustre 28-21 defeat of Japan and a narrow 29-26 loss against Australia in a game Wales could and maybe should have won. Those exciting occasions in Cardiff will now be followed by a trip to Twickenham to take on Eddie Jones' Japan. It takes some getting used to. Wales face double-header dilemma It will be a strange experience with Wales facing Japan on a Saturday afternoon before England play New Zealand for third place. Is it a double-header or will Wales be providing the curtain-raiser to the main event? Whichever way you view the occasion, Wales head coach Steve Tandy knows his side will have to provide their own atmosphere with a sparse crowd present for Friday afternoon's match between Italy and Fiji before Ireland took on Australia in the evening. "We've spoken about it all week," said Tandy. "There's also a 40-minute bus trip which is not normal either because we usually stay closer. "We have also spoken about it being an early kick-off. "There might be people walking in while the game is going on, the crowd might fill up as the game goes on, so there's all these little things to consider.” Tandy says the squad know Twickenham will not match the intensity of Cardiff's Principality Stadium during the past couple of weeks. "It is a different type of atmosphere for us after three massive games at home and being unbelievably well supported," said Tandy. "We've got to adapt a different sort of mindset and create that energy on the field for ourselves." Jenkins ready to resume Wales captaincy role A world-class winger - Louis Rees-Zammit 2.0 Wales look to World Cup when taking on Japan Does familiarity breed contempt with Japan? Wales finished fifth in the northern hemisphere table of the inaugural Nations Championship to face Japan, who finished in the same position in the southern standings. It will be the fifth time in 16 months the two sides have faced each other, with Wales winning three out of the four games. So opposing coaches Tandy and Jones will again lock horns. item.title: NFL insider: Brock Purdy's status 'up in the air' for 49ers-Seahawks
item.description: Brock Purdy of the San Francisco 49ers celebrates the 35-10 win against the Minnesota Vikings at Estadio Banorte on Nov. 22, 2026, in Mexico City. (Manuel Velasquez/Getty Images) As the San Francisco 49ers prepare for a pivotal showdown with their division rival Seahawks, it's still unclear whether Brock Purdy will play on Sunday. Purdy, who is in the midst of an MVP-caliber season, has missed the past two days of practice with an ankle sprain that occurred during last week's dominant win over the Vikings. And according to NFL Network insider Ian Rapoport, Purdy's status for Sunday is still "up in the air" as the Niners get back to the facility after Thanksgiving. On Friday's NFL Network " Good Morning Football " show, Rapoport said Purdy's injury has flown "under the radar," in part because he played through it and looked brilliant against Minnesota in Mexico City last week. In fact, some of Purdy's 49ers teammates didn't even realize he got hurt during the game because he kept on playing. But now that he's missed both practices on Wednesday and Thursday, his teammates are surely aware. Head coach Kyle Shanahan specified on Wednesday that Purdy doesn't have a high ankle sprain, which would knock him out for multiple weeks, but acknowledged it's possible that Purdy misses Sunday's game. Backup Mac Jones has been taking all of the reps in Purdy's place ahead of Friday's final 49ers practice, which Rapoport said will be pivotal. "If he, obviously, does not practice today, then doesn't bode well for him playing," he said. "If he is out there later today, probably going to make the start." We might not even need to wait until Sunday to find out for certain, either. Starting quarterbacks are effectively required to hold one interview session with reporters during the middle of the week before games. If the starter is ruled out, then the backup takes that spot. Purdy usually has his media session on Thursdays, but because of Thanksgiving, this week's presser was pushed to Friday. Purdy speaking on Friday won't immediately mean he's ruled out - after all, he spoke to reporters before the Rams game in Week 5 last year, but then didn't play in that game or in the following five games - but if it's Jones up there, that'll be a clear sign about what is set to happen on Sunday. Because the Bears beat the Lions to kick off a wild Thanksgiving slate, the 49ers need to beat the Seahawks to stay in the No. 1 spot in the NFC. Kickoff is set for Sunday at 1:25 p.m. on Fox. This article originally published at NFL insider: Brock Purdy's status 'up in the air' for 49ers-Seahawks .

item.title: Tom Brady Rips Aaron Rodgers for Violating the ‘Sanctity’ of the Locker Room
item.description: Pittsburgh Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers in a game against the Philadelphia Eagles on Nov. 22, 2026. -- Ed Thompson / Steelers Now During the Eagles-Cowboys game on Thanksgiving, Fox’s Tom Brady criticized Aaron Rodgers for violating the “ sanctity ” of the locker room. “It’s a privilege to be in that locker room,” Brady said. “You’re fighting with your teammates; you’re fighting with your coaches; you’re always acting as a team, together. [It] shouldn’t always be the place for private things to become public. That’s what I’ll say.” Brady recognized that Rodgers is an all-time great, but believes it should always be about the team first. “It has nothing to do with his play style,” Brady said. “I was fortunate to be around a lot of great teammates over the years, and what made a great teammate, to me, was you cared about your teammates and your coaches, and you cared about what the team was trying to accomplish. That supersedes any individual aspect of your game that you want to promote.” “Again, I was very fortunate. I was in a great locker room. I played for my teammates; I played for my coaches. There’s … nobody wins when the family feuds,” Brady added. The sanctity of an NFL locker room, it’s a very sacred place. We shouldn’t ever lose track of that as players. "The sanctity of an NFL locker room, it's a very sacred place" Tom Brady takes issue with how Aaron Rodgers handled his Steelers benching on Wednesday pic.twitter.com/gRRpgcKo41 — Awful Announcing (@awfulannouncing) November 27, 2026 Rodgers was benched and ultimately released after he set an ultimatum to Mike McCarthy over offensive play-calling. Rodgers demanded his release if changes weren’t made. Rodgers revealed on The Pat McAfee Show Wednesday that it was contentious during his last conversation with McCarthy. Rodgers told McCarthy that he thought it was in the best interest of the team for somebody else to call plays and if not, they should release him. Rodgers also claimed that McCarthy falls asleep during meetings and snores, and just flat-out misses meetings, and he doesn’t care to get to know the defensive players. So what was the breaking point for Rodgers? He said McCarthy saying “1-2-3 Packers” at halftime of Sunday’s game against the Philadelphia Eagles was the final straw. Rodgers said he doesn’t care about being released. That’s why he spoke up. “The truth is the truth,” he said.
